about: E3 retrieval set (plan A12): owner questions per machine, each with the one passage it must find. A passage is identified as documents.py records it: the file name and the section ('Title > Heading'). style: 'lexical' when the question reuses the passage's own key words, 'paraphrased' when it asks in other words (synonyms included). Written from the ROM documents before any search was run; never tuned on search results.
